trust_decision.summary: Whether a window that loads an arbitrary caller-supplied remote URL gets Node privileges: SearchService creates it with nodeIntegration:true/contextIsolation:false and loads the URL unchecked; the fix deletes the service and every route to it.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names SearchService nodeIntegration; the webPreferences block is the only nodeIntegration:true in src/main.

fix_sites.entry_point: service bootstrap (registers the IPC handlers at WhenReady)
window.api.searchService.openUrlInSearchWindow from any renderer with the app preload

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/renderer/utils/fetch.ts:87-88 (usingBrowser path; no production caller passes true, only src/renderer/utils/__tests__/fetch.test.ts:135)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The renderer usingBrowser path is dead (only CitationsList calls fetchWebContent without it, src/renderer/components/chat/messages/blocks/CitationsList.tsx:184), so a solver can harden webPreferences in SearchService and leave the wrapper alone; it falls with the main fix anyway.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Search window must still execute page JavaScript and return rendered outerHTML via executeJavaScript (JS-rendered pages); an over-broad fix that disables JS or removes the content return breaks browser-mode fetching.

O6_input_shapes: any URL string passed through SearchWindow_OpenUrl (no scheme check; http(s), file:, data: all loaded)
reuse of an existing window by uid vs creation of a new one (src/main/services/SearchService.ts:80-85)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A main-process 'local browser' fetch provider that renders the page in a hidden BrowserWindow with node-enabled webPreferences.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The renderer browser mode was moved to main-process providers; a maintainer porting the JS-rendering mode would plausibly copy SearchService's window options.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A registry window type whose webPreferences are deep-merged with caller overrides (src/main/core/window/windowRegistry.ts:508-513), so caller options could re-enable nodeIntegration for a remote-content window.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: SubWindow already omits explicit nodeIntegration/contextIsolation and relies on the merge plus Electron defaults; a defaults_or_merge route is plausible, but it would be a planted sibling, not real code.

O9_family: Electron insecure webPreferences: untrusted remote content loaded in a Node-integrated, non-isolated window (CWE-829)

O10_build.project_tests: src/renderer/utils/__tests__/fetch.test.ts (browser-mode test at :130-139, mocks window.api.searchService); main-process vitest tests mock electron (e.g. src/main/services/webSearch/providers/__tests__/factory.test.ts:19-29). No existing SearchService test.

j.j_sites_touched: src/main/services/SearchService.ts, src/main/core/application/serviceRegistry.ts, src/preload/index.ts, src/renderer/utils/fetch.ts, src/renderer/types/webSearchProvider.ts, src/shared/IpcChannel.ts (plus ~9 unrelated dead-IPC removals in the same commit)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set nodeIntegration:false/contextIsolation:true(/sandbox:true) in SearchService.createNewSearchWindow, which closes the published issue; tests can only check window options or that the IPC channel is gone.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit is a broad dead-IPC cleanup; most of its 65 sites (Python_Execute, File_*, VertexAI, Aes_Encrypt, Mcp_CallTool, etc.) are unrelated to this advisory's protection.
BaseService.ipcHandle registers handlers with no sender validation (src/main/core/lifecycle/BaseService.ts:114-132); validateSender only gates IpcApi (src/main/ipc/validateSender.ts:74-88).
In dev builds, webviews get the app preload injected (src/main/services/MainWindowService.ts:273-278).
unverified: Repo size in MB not measured.
Whether SearchService still exists in the latest release: no latest tree was provided.

Whether any remote-content frame (MiniApp webview, SubWindow) can reach window.api.searchService in a production build was not traced in full; webviews get no preload in prod per src/main/services/MainWindowService.ts:274-278.

The loaded page can navigate itself or redirect inside the node-enabled window (no will-navigate handler, since it is created outside WindowManager, cf. src/main/core/window/WindowManager.ts:1357), so a URL-allowlist fix is incomplete; recorded as a mechanism note, not as an O8 route.
